title: HSK 2.5 · 参加, 机会, 相信, 改变, 照片
focus: 场 · 件 · 或 · 头 · 周 · 参加 · 或者 · 机会 · 计划 · 信 · 队 · 相信 · 道 · 拉 · 帮助 · 变 · 加 · 努力 · 特别 · 掉 · 改变 · 讲 · 万 · 片 · 组 · 信息 · 照片 · 变成 · 改 · 加油 · 周末 · 油 · 头发 · 照顾 · 小组 · 出口 · 味道 · 出发 · 司机
body:
Words about doing and changing things: 加 add, 变/改 change, 信 trust/message, plus several measure words (场, 件, 条-style 片, 组). Many characters here are 'radical + sound' pairs, so the right-hand part often tells you the reading.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 加 | jiā | to add (力 strength + 口 mouth) | 加, 参加, 加油 |
| 变 | biàn | to change | 变, 改变, 变成 |
| 改 | gǎi | to change, correct (己 + 攵 action) | 改, 改变 |
| 信 | xìn | letter; to trust (亻 person + 言 words) | 信, 相信, 信息 |
| 片 | piàn | slice, flat piece | 片, 照片 |
| 组 | zǔ | group (纟 thread + 且 qiě, sound) | 组, 小组 |
| 照 | zhào | to shine; photograph; look after | 照片, 照顾 |
| 头 | tóu | head | 头, 头发 |

## Watch out

- 万 wàn (ten thousand) has no dot; 方 fāng has one.
- 周末: 末 mò end has the LONGER top stroke; 未 wèi (not yet, in 味) has the shorter top.
- 改 gǎi uses 己 jǐ, not 已 yǐ.

cards.Meaning: (measure word for games, shows, events); a place
cards.Example: 我们去看一场电影。 wǒmen qù kàn yì chǎng diànyǐng: Let's go see a movie
cards.Notes: 土 earth + phonetic part: a stretch of ground, a field (广场, 机场). Also read cháng for rain or illness: 一场雨

cards.Example: 我买了一件衣服。 wǒ mǎi le yí jiàn yīfu: I bought a piece of clothing
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 牛 cow = an item, one piece. Used for 衣服 and 事: 一件事

cards.Example: 你或我去都可以。 nǐ huò wǒ qù dōu kěyǐ: Either you or I can go
cards.Notes: 戈 dagger-axe + 口 + 一; mostly seen in 或者. Lookalike: 国 (traditional 國 contains 或)

cards.Example: 我头疼。 wǒ tóu téng: I have a headache
cards.Notes: Simplified from 頭 (页 head). As a suffix it's neutral tou: 木头, 前头

cards.Example: 下周我很忙。 xià zhōu wǒ hěn máng: I'm busy next week
cards.Notes: Means 'all around', so a full cycle: a week. 上周 last week, 周末 weekend

cards.Example: 你参加比赛吗？ nǐ cānjiā bǐsài ma: Are you entering the competition?
cards.Notes: 参 participate + 加 add = add yourself in, join

cards.Example: 喝茶或者咖啡都行。 hē chá huòzhě kāfēi dōu xíng: Tea or coffee, either is fine
cards.Notes: 或 or + 者 (suffix). Use 还是 for 'or' in questions

cards.Example: 这是一个好机会。 zhè shì yí ge hǎo jīhuì: This is a good opportunity
cards.Notes: 机 key moment (also machine) + 会 meeting = a meeting with the right moment

cards.Example: 你有什么计划？ nǐ yǒu shénme jìhuà: What are your plans?
cards.Notes: 计 count, plan (讠 speech + 十 ten) + 划 mark out (刂 knife) = a plan drawn up

cards.Example: 我给他写了一封信。 wǒ gěi tā xiě le yì fēng xìn: I wrote him a letter
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 言 words: a person standing by their words = trust; also a letter

cards.Example: 他是我们队的。 tā shì wǒmen duì de: He's on our team
cards.Notes: 阝 (mound, on the left) + 人 person = a group of people. In 排队 line up, 球队 team

cards.Example: 我相信你。 wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ: I believe you
cards.Notes: 相 each other (also 'look at': 木 + 目 eye) + 信 trust = to believe

cards.Meaning: road, way; to say; (measure word for questions)
cards.Example: 这道题很难。 zhè dào tí hěn nán: This question is hard
cards.Notes: 辶 walking + 首 head = the way you walk ahead. In 知道 (neutral dao), 味道

cards.Example: 请拉门。 qǐng lā mén: Please pull the door
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 立 lì (sound) = to pull. Opposite: 推 tuī push

cards.Example: 谢谢你的帮助。 xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù: Thanks for your help
cards.Notes: 帮 help + 助 help (力 strength + 且, sound) = helping; two near-synonyms

cards.Example: 天气变冷了。 tiānqì biàn lěng le: The weather has turned cold
cards.Notes: Top part (亦) + 又 hand. Simplified from 變. Lookalike: 恋 liàn (心 bottom)

cards.Example: 咖啡里加点糖。 kāfēi lǐ jiā diǎn táng: Add a little sugar to the coffee
cards.Notes: 力 strength + 口 mouth: adding force with words. 一加一 = one plus one

cards.Example: 他学习很努力。 tā xuéxí hěn nǔlì: He studies hard
cards.Notes: 努 strive (奴 nú sound + 力) + 力 strength = put in all your strength

cards.Example: 今天特别热。 jīntiān tèbié rè: It's especially hot today
cards.Notes: 特 special (牛 + 寺 sì, sound) + 别 different = set apart, special

cards.Meaning: to drop, fall; (after verbs) away, off
cards.Example: 我的手机掉了。 wǒ de shǒujī diào le: I dropped my phone
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 卓 zhuó (sound). After a verb = gone: 吃掉 eat up, 忘掉 forget

cards.Example: 他改变了主意。 tā gǎibiàn le zhǔyi: He changed his mind
cards.Notes: 改 change, correct + 变 change = to change (on purpose)

cards.Example: 老师讲得很清楚。 lǎoshī jiǎng de hěn qīngchu: The teacher explains clearly
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 井 jǐng (sound) = to speak, explain. 讲故事 tell a story

cards.Example: 这个要一万块。 zhège yào yí wàn kuài: This costs ten thousand yuan
cards.Notes: Simplified from 萬. Lookalike: 方 fāng has a dot on top; 万 does not

cards.Meaning: slice, flat piece; (measure word for flat things)
cards.Example: 吃一片面包吧。 chī yí piàn miànbāo ba: Have a slice of bread
cards.Notes: Shows half of 木 wood split down the middle: a flat slice. In 照片 photo, 名片 card

cards.Example: 我们分三个组。 wǒmen fēn sān ge zǔ: We'll split into three groups
cards.Notes: 纟 thread + 且 qiě (sound) = threads tied together, a group

cards.Example: 我收到你的信息了。 wǒ shōudào nǐ de xìnxī le: I got your message
cards.Notes: 信 message + 息 news, breath (自 nose + 心 heart) = information

cards.Example: 这是我小时候的照片。 zhè shì wǒ xiǎoshíhou de zhàopiàn: This is a photo of me as a kid
cards.Notes: 照 shine, photograph (灬 fire + 昭 zhāo, sound) + 片 flat piece = photograph

cards.Example: 水变成了冰。 shuǐ biànchéng le bīng: The water turned into ice
cards.Notes: 变 change + 成 become = change into

cards.Example: 我改一下作业。 wǒ gǎi yíxià zuòyè: Let me fix my homework
cards.Notes: 己 + 攵 action (hand with stick) = to correct. 己 jǐ here, not 已 yǐ

cards.Meaning: come on! go for it!; to refuel
cards.Example: 加油！你能行！ jiāyóu! nǐ néng xíng: Come on, you can do it!
cards.Notes: 加 add + 油 oil = refuel, so 'keep going!' — what fans shout

cards.Example: 周末你做什么？ zhōumò nǐ zuò shénme: What are you doing this weekend?
cards.Notes: 周 week + 末 end = weekend. 末 mò (long top line) vs 未 wèi (short top line)

cards.Example: 这个菜太油了。 zhège cài tài yóu le: This dish is too oily
cards.Notes: 氵 liquid + 由 yóu (sound) = oil

cards.Example: 她的头发很长。 tā de tóufa hěn cháng: Her hair is long
cards.Notes: 头 head + 发 hair (simplified from 髮; same character as 发 send) = head hair

cards.Meaning: to take care of, look after
cards.Example: 我照顾我妈妈。 wǒ zhàogù wǒ māma: I look after my mom
cards.Notes: 照 shine on, look after + 顾 look back at (页 head) = to watch over

cards.Example: 我们小组有五个人。 wǒmen xiǎozǔ yǒu wǔ ge rén: Our group has five people
cards.Notes: 小 small + 组 group = small group

cards.Example: 出口在哪儿？ chūkǒu zài nǎr: Where's the exit?
cards.Notes: 出 go out + 口 opening = way out. Opposite: 入口 entrance

cards.Example: 这个菜味道不错。 zhège cài wèidao búcuò: This dish tastes good
cards.Notes: 味 taste (口 mouth + 未 wèi, sound) + 道 way = the way it tastes

cards.Example: 我们八点出发。 wǒmen bā diǎn chūfā: We set off at eight
cards.Notes: 出 go out + 发 send off, start = to start out

cards.Example: 他是出租车司机。 tā shì chūzūchē sījī: He's a taxi driver
cards.Notes: 司 manage, operate + 机 machine = the one operating the machine, the driver
